messages:
Ajay (Sales): FYI passing CoveOptics over to CS — signed enterprise trial (50k tokens/day) with option to convert to Dedicated next quarter. key dates: onboarding kickoff 2026-05-10, expected pilot end 2026-06-07. SSO (Okta) + VPC peering required.
Maya (CS): Thanks Ajay — forwarding to support for infra checklist. two immediate risks: 1) VPC peering timeline from customer (they said 2-3 weeks) 2) pilot needs embeddings + rerank, might require extra mem on our Serving runtime.
Devon (Support): Noted. Do we have sample traffic profile? tokens/req, concurrency?
Ajay (Sales): Customer expect ~200 qps in peak testing, avg request ~350 tokens, embedding calls ~40% of flows. They've asked for latency <350ms for gen endpoints.
Ravi (Solutions): Ping me for model selection. Recommend quantized llama-2-13B-retrieval for embeddings then gpt-like 7B for gen to meet latency. We'll probably need dedicated pool for pilot ramp.
Maya (CS): Action items — owners: (1) Provision initial sandbox and example dataset (Maya) (2) VPC peering contact + timeline (CoveOps: they assigned @emma.c) (Ajay to nudge) (3) Support infra validation for embedding memory and KV cache (Devon) (4) Eng ticket for private deploy configs + IP allowlist (Ravi) (5) Enablement session + playbook for CoveOptics POC (Maya).
Ajay (Sales): I've looped in Emma at CoveOptics; she said networking team can start on 2026-04-20. I'll confirm today. :thumbsup:
Devon (Support): I'll run a quick perf calc. if 200 qps * 350 tokens -> ~70k tokens/sec -> with batching likely need 4x A100-equivalent for stable latency. I'll open infra-check thread and attach profiling steps.
Ravi (Solutions): Opening eng ticket: ENG-6821 — request private deployment template for VPC peering, IP allowlist and SSO cert exchange. tagging @security for cert rotation notes. (link: https://redwood.internal/eng/ENG-6821)
Maya (CS): Can we schedule a 30m enablement call with CoveOptics devs week of 2026-05-04? Need walkthrough of API keys, rate limits, and best-practice for embedding batching. I'll draft agenda.
Devon (Support): Quick note: embeddings storage requires encryption-at-rest in their VPC for compliance. Confirming whether they need HSM-backed KMS — @Ravi?
Ravi (Solutions): They indicated enterprise compliance; add KMS/HSM as optional step. I'll include KMS integration checklist in ENG-6821.
Ajay (Sales): Renewal/expansion signal: CoveOptics wants SLA before converting to dedicated. High priority to show stable pilot metrics. Tracking renewal risk: low if latency & peering are on schedule, otherwise medium.
Maya (CS): I'll capture customer feedback during enablement and set up post-kickoff survey. Prep the success playbook and share with team by 2026-05-07.
org-bot: Reminder: provisioning runbook v2 deployed to #eng-infra yesterday.
Devon (Support): My infra-check thread: "1860004390-infra-check-coveoptics" — adding resource estimations and test commands.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. Next sync: 2026-04-21 10:00 PT to confirm peering start. Owners: Ajay (confirm networking), Maya (playbook & sandbox), Devon (infra validation), Ravi (ENG ticket). :rocket:
Ajay (Sales): On it.
Maya (CS): Closing note — capture any blocker ASAP in this thread and tag @Ravi/Devon.
